steps.en: Install the router and game-dev skill catalog
steps.zh: 安装路由器与游戏技能目录

steps.en: Expose short skill descriptions for selection
steps.zh: 提供简短技能说明，供助手选择

steps.en: Ask for a double jump in your Godot project
steps.zh: 在 Godot 工程中请求加二段跳

steps.en: Identify engine/version and read movement plus platformer guides
steps.zh: 识别版本，读移动与平台跳跃指引

steps.en: Guide controller edits using the selected engine recipe
steps.zh: 按所选引擎配方指导角色控制器修改

value.en: Stop rebuilding the engine-and-gameplay briefing for every request; you still compile and playtest
value.zh: 不必每次重讲引擎与玩法规则；编译和试玩仍由你负责
